question: In which week of 2000 did emails mentioning Raptor peak?

steps.text: I'm going to count the "Raptor" emails by week for 2000 to find the peak, then read what was written around it. Calling mail_counts now.

Plan: (1) count emails mentioning "Raptor" by week in 2000 to find the peak; (2) check variants and sources; (3) read what was written in the peak week.

Checking weekly counts of "Raptor" in 2000.
Peak is the week ending 2000-09-03. Now I'll check what the emails said that week.

steps.summary: 10 results, 10 of them people's own mail

answer:
The peak was the week ending Sunday 2000-09-03 (the last week of August plus 1 September). The weekly count came from the mail_counts tool.

- **Peak week:** That week had 27 emails mentioning "Raptor". The count was the same when I limited it to people's own mail and added variants such as "Raptor I" and "Raptor III". The next-highest weeks were the week ending 09-17 with 22 and the week ending 09-24 with 18. Before the peak the count was at most 7 a week (week ending 08-20). After the 09-03 week it stayed high through early October, then fell to 1–8 a week.
- **What the mail that week was about:** the structuring of the Raptor hedging vehicles.
  - On 2000-08-30, Stuart Zisman asked staff to hand over warrant documents, writing that "the internal pressure to push investments into Raptor has increased exponentially."
  - Also on 08-30, Scott Sefton wrote to the group about the swaps: the swaps for assets in JEDI 1 and 2 would be between Harrier and Talon, with no back-to-back swap with JEDI.
  - Another email from Sefton that day said "Raptor 3 is now on. It will be the same as Raptor 2. We're also now going to do Raptor 4, a radically different structure using RESCO warrants."
  - On 08-29, Vinson & Elkins sent drafts for Project Raptor III, including the Roadrunner and Bobcat LLC agreements and an LJM Management Services Agreement.
  - On 09-01, Mary Cook wrote about the notice under the equity swap, saying it should be addressed to Talon c/o LJM2 Co-Investment, L.P.

I checked the counts two ways but did not read every one of the 27 emails. The description of the week's content is based on the top search hits.
